name: Wizard OS Tracker
short_desc: Goals and Bugs on GitHub: Queued → Building → Review → Done, issue on tap.
author: Humanity Labs
description: Two views over a GitHub organisation, Goals and Bugs, each showing the assembly line Queued → Building → Review → Done as big numbers with arrows (tap a step for who does it), small bottleneck stats, a Builder switch (mock-up), Everyone and repo filters, and a Try it switch on items in Review (mock-up). Tap an issue to read it and its comments in the app. Each person signs in with their own GitHub token.
